halomcc-i-m-sorry-dave-c5354b9fe4.guideDescription:
Iji kpọghee mmezu nke "I’m Sorry, Dave" na Halo: Reach n'ime Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), ị ga-achọ ịchọta akwa Ista nke na-asọpụrụ David Candland, onye isi UI egwuregwu ahụ. Nke a bụ ntuziaka zuru ezu maka otu esi achọta ya:

2. Buru ngwa ọgụ nke ** na-enweghị ** nwere njirimara mbugharị. Ihe atụ ndị a na-ahụkarị gụnyere Assault Rifle ma ọ bụ Plasma Pistol.
3. Pịa bọtịnụ mbugharị (na-abụkarị mkpanaka aka nri na consoles ma ọ bụ igodo ahapụtara na PC) gaa na "zoom in" na ngwa agha gị na-enweghị atụ.
4. Lee anya na ** ala aka ekpe ** nke ihuenyo gị. Ị ga-ahụ eriri koodu ọnụọgụ abụọ na-apụta obere oge.
5. Koodu ọnụọgụ abụọ a tụgharịrị gaa na okwu "Dave" na nnọchite anya ọnụọgụ abụọ ASCII.

Site n'ịgbaso usoro ndị a na idobe koodu ọnụọgụ abụọ, ị ga-emepe mmezu "I’m Sorry, Dave".

halomcc-brovershield-0ccc5f822c.guideDescription: Iji kpọghee "Brovershield" na Halo: The Master Chief Collection (MCC), kpọọ onye mmekọ n'ime ụlọ mkpọsa gị, họrọ obere ozi ị maara nke ọma, wee tọọ ihe isi ike na Heroic. halomcc-a-pile-of-medals-f80eff0712.description: Chịkọta mkpọsa 2,000 ma ọ bụ ihe nrite ndepụta ọkpụkpọ.

A na-atụ aro igwu egwu na ihe isi ike dị mfe na mkpọsa ahụ, ebe ọ na-enye gị ohere ịkwakọba nrite n'enweghị ihe ịma aka agbakwunyere nke ihe isi ike dị elu.
